summary: Destructive Windows wiper payload chained from sole exported function
details: Package exports a single function `sorgu(userId)` in index.js that sequentially invokes 26 modules (a.js through z.js under public/a/b/.../z/) which together perform catastrophic, unrecoverable destruction of a Windows installer. Observed behaviors: e.js opens `\\.\PhysicalDrive0` for read+write and zero-fills the MBR; c.js recursively unlinks `C:\Windows\System32`; s.js unlinks SAM and SECURITY registry hives; b.js unlinks the C:\ root and shells `del /F /S /Q C:\*.*`; i.js and y.js implement fork bombs spawning `process.argv[0]` detached in a loop and `cmd /c for /l %i in (0,0,0) do echo %random%`; h.js allocates 1GB Buffers in an infinite loop; w.js overwrites `C:\pagefile.sys` and `C:\hiberfil.sys` with 500MB of `x` bytes; additional modules disable boot recovery via bcdedit, terminate csrss/winlogon, hijack the hosts file, and force shutdown. Module a.js downloads a JPEG from `cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1525228680803123300/1532140349378531328/photo-output.jpg` and forces it fullscreen via `start`, `mshta` ActiveX, and PowerShell Forms as an intimidation/branding banner before the wipe. No legitimate utility functionality is present in the package.
